description: Permissions for the main window. The shell reads the OS theme this way, and starts the OS window drag from the chrome's title-bar region; `core:window:default` is the read-only set plus the internal maximize toggle that the region's double-click uses, so `start_dragging` is the only command it lacks (PG-E1-03). The core's own commands are not listed because this ACL does not gate them, and neither `tauri-plugin-window-state` nor any other plugin is listed because the webview calls none of them.
